analyzed_vuln.description: In `RDKit::Chirality::iterateCIPRanks`, each `cipEntries[i]` vector is initialized with only 2 elements (`atomicNum`, `rank`) but later, inside the refinement loop, code unconditionally writes `cipEntries[i][numIts + 1] = ranks[i]` (line ~969). As `numIts` grows, this index can exceed the current vector size (especially when an entry has few/no neighbors and remains short), causing an out-of-bounds write into vector capacity (ASan container-overflow). The crash is at this write site, and the bug is missing bounds-safe growth before indexed assignment.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: The deserialization harness (`mol_deserialization_fuzzer`) feeds crafted pickle bytes into `MolPickler::molFromPickle()`, which for older pickle versions calls `MolOps::assignStereochemistry()`, then `legacyStereoPerception()`, then `assignAtomCIPRanks()`, reaching `iterateCIPRanks()`. A malformed but accepted molecule topology/ranking state that keeps CIP refinement iterating while some `cipEntries[i]` are not long enough for `numIts+1` triggers the OOB indexed write at line ~969.
